notes.survey_weight: V1032 = annual visit-1 weight with calibration (V1028 is the quarterly-file weight and does not exist in this file)
notes.household_income_per_capita_brl: VD5008 (habitual from all jobs + effective from other sources; excludes pensionistas, domestic workers and their relatives). Reproduces IBGE SIDRA 7435 Gini 2025 = 0.511 (computed 0.5112). VD5002 (all effective) gives 0.5226 and is not the published concept.
notes.household_size: V2001 official number of persons in the household; no household keys are read
notes.amounts: nominal R$ per month of the reference month; no deflator applied
